script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The passage says Ezekiel saw water, but does not say there was no smoke at all.
The batch joke is unclear: it is not apparent whether the batch looks like smoke or water, or why that would make him happy.
The measurements show increasing depth over distance, not how slowly the water builds.
Ezekiel does not walk through every measured stretch. At the fourth, the river cannot be crossed on foot.
The passage says the water is waist-deep, but does not say Ezekiel's chin stays dry.
The passage does not say nobody is camping there.
The passage does not say there are no walls or that the trees are lined up.
The passage says the water becomes fresh, not that the river takes nothing away from the sea.
The passage does not establish that there is no blood anywhere in the vision.
The claim that the fishermen will need bigger buckets adds a detail the passage does not give.
Papa comments on how he is telling the passage: he will tell the baker what the man said and leave the rest alone.
The passage does not say there are no animals grazing in the swamps and marshes.
Papa comments on how he is telling the passage when he says he is not adding anything to it.
The leaves not withering does not establish that they stay put.
The apron comparison does not make sense: an apron does not wither like a leaf.
The passage does not say that the fishermen can just fish because the river waters the trees.
The passage does not say nobody is setting up a loom by the river.
